```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidypopgen)
library(tidygenclust)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(readxl)

# Set cores
n_cores <- 10
data.table::setDTthreads(n_cores)
bigparallelr::set_blas_ncores(n_cores)
```


```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- "../results/s05_fastmixture/"
```

# Load data

```{r}
NEO_full <- gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_full.gt", 
                    reattach_to = "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_full")
```

# Filter loci

```{r}
NEO_full <- NEO_full %>% group_by(population)
loci_report_m <- qc_report_loci(NEO_full)
NEO_full <- NEO_full %>% ungroup()

to_keep <- which(loci_report_m$hwe_p > 0.01)
NEO_full <- NEO_full %>% select_loci(all_of(to_keep))
count_loci(NEO_full)
NEO_full <-
  NEO_full %>% select_loci_if(loci_missingness(genotypes) < 0.02)
count_loci(NEO_full)
NEO_full <-
  NEO_full %>% select_loci_if(loci_maf(genotypes) > 0.025)
count_loci(NEO_full)
```

# Filter indivs

```{r}
# temporarily remove all populations with only one individual
pop_tbl <- table(NEO_full$population)
to_remove <- which(pop_tbl == 1)
to_remove_pops <- names(to_remove) # this removes a lot of DRC samples and some Mozambique samples (relevant)

removed_pops <- NEO_full %>%
  filter(population %in% to_remove_pops)

NEO_full <-
  NEO_full %>% filter(!population %in% to_remove_pops)

# filter indivs
NEO_full <- NEO_full %>% group_by(population)
individual_report_m <-
  qc_report_indiv(NEO_full, kings_threshold = 0.0884)
NEO_full <- NEO_full %>% ungroup()
NEO_full <-
  NEO_full %>% filter(id %in% individual_report_m$id & individual_report_m$to_keep == TRUE)

if(file.exists("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_full_rebind.bk")){
  file.remove("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_full_rebind.bk")
  file.remove("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_full_rebind.gt")
  file.remove("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_full_rebind.rds")
}

# bind them together again
NEO_full <- rbind(NEO_full, removed_pops, backingfile = "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_full_rebind")

NEO_full <-
  NEO_full %>% filter(indiv_missingness(genotypes) < 0.1)
```

# Fastmixture

Fortez-Lima et al 2023: K = 2 to K = 25. 
Paper metadata included K = 4 and K = 16 (but this included non-African samples)

```{r}
# group
k <- c(10:25)
  qmats <- gt_fastmixture(NEO_full,
    k,
    n_runs = 3,
    threads = 10,
    batches = 16,
    seed = c(1,2,3),
    no_freqs = TRUE
  )
saveRDS(qmats, paste0(res_dir, "fastmixture_test.RData"))
```

## Recording R environment

Part of ensuring our workflow is reproducible is to keep track of the R environment.
We will automatically save our R environment into a file called `r_environment.json`.

```{r save-r-environment, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
filename_rmd <- "s05d_fastmixture_bantu_populations.Rmd"
filename_renv <- paste0(
  res_dir, "/renv_",
  tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filename_rmd)),
  ".json"
)
renv::lockfile_write(renv::lockfile_create(), file = filename_renv)

```
